costControlPrinciples: Cost control is not about cutting everything — it is about eliminating waste while investing in growth
Every dollar of operating cost reduction at the same revenue level drops directly to net profit
Fixed costs are the most dangerous — they persist regardless of revenue. Keep fixed costs low; scale through variable costs.
Review all recurring subscriptions quarterly — subscription creep is real and compounds over time

operatingExpenseBenchmarks.salaries_and_wages: 30–40% of net revenue at TCD's stage — scale carefully
operatingExpenseBenchmarks.marketing: 8–12% of net revenue for active growth phase; 5–8% for maintenance phase
operatingExpenseBenchmarks.software_subscriptions: Target under 2% of net revenue — audit quarterly
operatingExpenseBenchmarks.professional_services: 2–3% of net revenue (accounting, legal, HR consulting)
operatingExpenseBenchmarks.rent_utilities: Under 5% of net revenue — avoid long-term leases that constrain flexibility
operatingExpenseBenchmarks.insurance: 1–1.5% of net revenue — do not underinsure to save cost

costsToInvestIn: Sales capability — highest ROI investment for a project sales business
Marketing (Google Ads + SEO) — compound return over time
Project management systems — prevent expensive errors and rework
Key person insurance — protects the business if a critical person is unavailable
Accounting software — Xero or equivalent; pays for itself in time savings and accuracy
costsToControlStrictly: Installation subcontractors — get 3 quotes for each new installer relationship
Freight — renegotiate annually as volume grows; shipping rates are negotiable
Bank fees — use a business banking account with low transaction fees
Office supplies and incidentals — small but can drift significantly without a budget

wasteIdentification.quotesThatDontConvert: If quote-to-order rate drops below 25%, the issue is either lead quality or quote presentation — fix the process before spending more on lead generation
wasteIdentification.unacknowledgedScopeCreep: Untracked project additions that erode margin — implement a formal change order process
wasteIdentification.excessiveRevision: More than 2 rounds of quote revision for a single project signals either unclear briefing or unclear scope — fix the intake process
wasteIdentification.overdueReceivables: Overdue invoices are a hidden cost — late payment means TCD is funding the client's business
